reuse.why: Introduces one getFillableCategories selection and a forEachBulkCategory loop that every month-wide action uses, and routes the averages through the existing setNMonthAvg instead of re-inlining it.

duplication.why: The three copied category queries and loops are collapsed; only the income-outside-tracking check is still repeated in copyPreviousMonth alongside forEachBulkCategory.

placement.why: Selection rules and actions stay in budget/actions.ts and the new handler is registered in budget/app.ts with the other budget methods.

scope.why: Focused on the four steps; consolidating set3MonthAvg onto setNMonthAvg is a small related refactor beyond the requests.

maintainability.why: Each exclusion (hidden, templates, #fixed) is defined once and the hidden opt-in is one defaulted parameter, so future rule changes are made in a single place.

abstraction_drift.where: getFillableCategories gained includeHiddenCategories (step 4); copyPreviousMonth uses the shared selection but keeps its own income/tracking check instead of forEachBulkCategory
